item.title: Back to the 90s
item.author: Alexander Deprez
item.description: I am fat. I don’t like it, but I am. My weight has been a struggle throughout my life. At the age of 18 my weight reached a first peak at 112kg. That was my “I’ve had it” moment. Not eating much anymore, and going to the gym everyday for 2 hours, I lost 26kg in 4 months. My life changed completely. I was more confident, I felt better, and I was more active.
